description: Held-out synthetic job descriptions, written blind to the extractor (independent author). Labels: catalogue skills only.

items.text: Data Analyst | Bengaluru | 4-6 LPA. Strong SQL and MS-Excel (VLOOKUP, pivots). Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI. Good communication skills required.
Backend Developer (2-4 yrs). Python, FastAPI, Postgres. Docker knowledge is a plus. No Java needed for this role.
Field Sales Executive, Pune. Must excel in client handling and react quickly to customer queries. Fluent Hindi/Marathi, own two-wheeler. Good interpersonal skills a must.
Campus Drive - 2026 batch, B.Tech CSE/IT only. Written test on DSA + aptitude. Candidates should be comfortable coding in Java. Team player attitude expected. 60% throughout.
Hiring ReactJS Developer: JS (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Redux, TypeScript. Git/GitHub mandatory. Next.js good to have. WFO Hyderabad.
Java Full Stack Developer - Spring Boot, Microservices, Angular 14, AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda), Kafka, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Oracle DB. 5+ yrs. Immediate joiners preferred. Hyderabad.
Barista wanted at our Koramangala outlet! Prepare espresso, Java and filter coffee blends. Good communication with customers and ability to work as part of a team in rotating shifts.
ML Engineer: Python, NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch. Strong in statistics and probability. Exposure to MLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow) desirable. Docker preferred. Build and deploy ML models.
SAP FICO Consultant - S/4HANA implementation, GL, AP/AR, asset accounting, ABAP debugging basics. Client-facing role requiring strong communication. Excel knowledge an added advantage.
HR Recruiter (Non-IT), Noida. Sourcing via Naukri, LinkedIn, references. Excellent verbal and written communication. Salary 2.4 LPA + incentives.
DevOps Engineer - Linux administration, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS/Azure. Git branching strategies, CI/CD via Jenkins. Shell scripting. Python scripting is a bonus.
Android Developer: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Retrofit, Room, Firebase, Play Store publishing. Java is not required for this role. Working knowledge of Git.
Business Analyst - Tableau dashboards, advanced Excel, writing SQL queries. Stakeholder communication. Power BI not needed (we are a Tableau shop).
Data Science Intern (6 months, stipend 25k/month). Python, pandas, basic ML. Knowledge of statistics. Should be a quick learner with problem-solving ability.
Join ABC Institute as Admission Counsellor! Our placement statistics speak for themselves - 92% placed. Need someone with convincing communication and a target-driven mindset. Walk-in Mon-Sat.
Django Developer, remote. Python 3.x, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Celery, Redis. Pure backend - no React/Angular work. Linux server deployment experience.
Software Engineer Trainee. Good knowledge of data structures and algorithms in any language. Strong analytical skills. 2-year service agreement. Package 3.6 LPA.
MIS Executive - maintain daily reports in MS Excel (macros, VBA) and Google Sheets. Basic SQL preferred. Good with numbers, attention to detail.
Delivery Partner - food delivery. Own bike, smartphone and valid DL. Earn up to 30k/month + petrol allowance. No experience needed. Join today!
QA Automation Engineer: Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, Java, Cucumber BDD, Jenkins, JIRA, Postman, REST Assured. Good communication skills. 3-6 yrs, Pune.
Data Engineer - PySpark, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, Airflow, Delta Lake. Strong SQL and Python. Git for version control. Hybrid, Gurugram.
Web Designer: HTML, CSS, Figma, Adobe XD. JavaScript a plus. You should excel at translating mockups into pixel-perfect pages.
Full Stack (MERN) Developer: MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js, JavaScript (ES6). REST APIs. Git. Docker good-to-have. Must be a team player.
Reporting Analyst: Power BI, DAX, SQL Server. No coding in Python/R required. Strong data analysis, plus communication and presentation skills.
Quant Research Intern: statistics, probability, Python (NumPy). C++ is a plus. Competitive programming / algorithms background preferred. Mumbai, stipend 80k.
Customer Support Associate (Voice) - night shift, Gurgaon. Fluent English and good communication. Typing 30 wpm. Must react calmly under pressure. Cab facility.
Linux System Admin: RHEL/CentOS, bash scripting, cron, Nginx, Apache, LVM. On-call rotation. Docker not required.
Data Analyst Fresher: Excel, SQL, Python (pandas, numpy), Power BI (Tableau a plus). Statistics basics and hands-on data analysis. Good communication.
iOS Developer: Swift, SwiftUI, Xcode, CoreData, Combine, App Store deployment. Git. Problem-solving mindset. 6-12 LPA.
Content Writer - tech blogs. Excellent written communication in English. Knowledge of SEO and WordPress. Familiarity with Python or ML topics is a bonus for writing tutorials.
Python Developer (Automation), Chennai. Selenium, requests, BeautifulSoup scripts. Linux CLI. Git. 3-5 LPA.
Backend Java Developer: Core Java, collections, multithreading, JDBC, MySQL / SQL queries. Interview has problem-solving and DSA rounds.
Mobile Developer: React and React Native, TypeScript, Redux. No web frontend (HTML/CSS) work involved.
Accountant - Tally ERP, GST filing, TDS, bank reconciliation. MS-Excel must. B.Com graduates, 1-3 yrs, Coimbatore.
Office Assistant - Andheri East. Tea/coffee service, filing, courier handling. 10th pass. Must be punctual and work well with the team.
ML Engineer (NLP): transformers, Hugging Face, LangChain, vector DBs, AWS SageMaker. Machine learning fundamentals and Python must. Docker, FastAPI preferred. Kubernetes nice to have.
Graduate Engineer Trainee (Mechanical) - AutoCAD, SolidWorks, GD&T, shop floor exposure. No IT skills required. Diploma/BE Mech.
Junior Data Analyst - Excel, SQL. We do not use Tableau here. Should be able to clean and analyse datasets and explain insights clearly to managers.
Frontend Intern: HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript. You will learn React on the job (not required beforehand). Git basics.
Reptile Keeper - Mysuru zoo. Care for reptiles including the Indian rock python and cobras. Communicate safety rules to visitors and work closely with the vet team.
